en:
Can you imagine?
If this volcano were to erupt?\pThe explosion would be the end of
us. How terrifying is that?\pWhile we're terrified, would you
like me to teach EXPLOSION?
Yeah, you're right.\nIt is too terrifying.
You're terribly brave!\pWhich POKéMON should I teach\nEXPLOSION?
Using EXPLOSION while on this\nvolcano…\pWhat a terrifying thrill!
Over here.\nWe'll try digging here.\pThat treasure the ADMINS've been\ntalking about should be here.
What the…?\nYou're in the way. Get lost.
Whew, punched through at last.\nLet's go treasure hunting!
Any treasure we find, we haul back\nto the WAREHOUSE, understood?\p…Oh, and what're the passwords?\nAt the ROCKET WAREHOUSE, I mean.
What, you forgot the password?\nThere're actually two.\pThe first one's “GOLDEEN need\nlog.”\pAnd the second one is…
Hey!\nThis snoop's been listening in!
You've been eavesdropping on us,\nhaven't you?
Huh, what?
Why'd you have to win?
Trying to horn in on our treasure?\nDon't bet on it!
Wait!\nBut how?
Develop amnesia conveniently and\nforget everything you heard!

What a setback…
We'll have to regroup.\pYou! Don't even think about taking
a step inside here!\pIf you know what's good for you,
don't even think about this!
An active volcano is one that's\nerupting, or about to.
Whew… That was hot!\nSweat's erupting from me!
They say there're over 1,500\nactive volcanoes in the world.\pJust thinking about them makes me\nfeel all hot and gooey inside!
Do you know how caves form inside\nvolcanoes?
Atchah!\nYou're shockingly good!
When lava at the surface of magma\nhardens, and the magma inside flows\lout, caverns are left behind.
I've been in training so I can mend\nmy broken heart…\pIt toughened me up physically at\nleast! Hi-yah!
I think I tried to overdo it…
The way you battle, it reminds me\nof the guy who dumped me…
